Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Yasi Orel: 22-year-old woman, 193 cm (very-tall), unmistakably soft rounded construction with a clearly evident, naturally wider middle, short-to-average limbs, no cinched or flat waist, and gentle limb contours, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: round full face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, bob-pageboy, deliberate accent: hidden undercut. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a shallow cheek scar. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a string-bound recipe leaf only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
